ideas.title: Window View: landmarks labelled on the camera
ideas.body: Hold your phone up to the plane window and the landmarks outside are labelled on the camera picture, from mountain tops to cities and lakes. Tap a label for its story. Open it with the camera button on the Live map; it works offline.

ideas.title: Best Side to Sit
ideas.body: When you add a flight, AirReveal tells you which window to book, left or right, the landmarks you'll see from it and whether you'll catch the sunrise or sunset. Worked out on your phone, so it works before you've even booked.

ideas.title: Flight HUD on the map
ideas.body: Altitude, speed and heading on the map, with what you're flying over and which side to look, as a glass panel or cockpit-style tapes. Turn it on or off in Profile › Flight HUD.

ideas.title: Offline maps you can count on
ideas.body: A flight only shows as "Available offline" once its map has finished downloading, with its size. A download that was cut short carries on where it stopped, and one that fails can be tried again.

ideas.title: Download maps automatically on Wi-Fi
ideas.body: A new flight's maps and landmarks download by themselves while you're on Wi-Fi. Turn it on or off in Profile › Trip Data.

ideas.title: Choose your units
ideas.body: Automatic, Aviation, Metric or Imperial, for altitude, speed, distance and weather. In Profile › Flight HUD › Units.

ideas.title: The weather below your plane on the Home Screen widget
ideas.body: The widget now shows the weather below your plane, as well as your flight.

ideas.title: Flight HUD on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
ideas.body: Your heading, altitude, speed and which side to look, on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island while you fly.

ideas.title: Flight HUD beside the flight panel on iPad
ideas.body: On iPad in landscape, the Flight HUD now shows beside the flight panel instead of over the map.
